title: Auth account and activity layout refinement
content:
Tonight's Auth pass stayed focused on making the administration surface read more like the rest of the JeffersonWM tools: flatter, calmer, and easier to scan without turning account data into a stack of heavy cards.

What changed:

  • Perihelion-style headings: Auth page titles and account names now use the same Inter Tight, bold, uppercase, tight-tracking treatment as Perihelion. Every account name carries a direct lifecycle label: Registered, Approved, Blocked, or Deleted.
  • Flatter account surface: standard cards, panels, and identity blocks no longer create solid background containers. The main page frame now keeps content inside the gutter lines with a consistent inset instead.
  • Readable app memberships: account app names remain individual links, separated by ordinary text spaces outside the links. They wrap as a normal left-aligned paragraph rather than becoming one continuous underline or a hanging-indent list.
  • Activity calibration: Activity log rows now use a restrained 50% dark fill, preserving row definition while allowing the shared background to remain visible.

The broader direction is intentionally incremental: shared page language where it helps, but small per-surface adjustments when the administrative data needs a clearer reading rhythm.
